descriptor: Sheet, plate and tube metal fabrication

voice.summary: Ferrous speaks in measurements and verbs, like a foreman writing on a job ticket. It is short, direct and proud of tolerance, and it never softens a spec.
dos: Use millimetres and materials, not adjectives
Name the job type: cut, fold, weld, finish
donts: Do not round a tolerance to look good
Do not apologise for lead times

taglines: Cut to a tenth of a millimetre
Checked with a square, by hand
boilerplate: Ferrous is a metal-fabrication shop that cuts sheet, plate and tube to a tenth of a millimetre and finishes every part by hand.

microcopy.success: Job received. We will quote within one working day.
microcopy.error: File rejected. Send a DXF or STEP under 50 MB.
microcopy.empty: No jobs in the queue yet.

logo.note: Stacked bars suggest bar stock and plate, and a heavy uppercase wordmark matches the grid.
